protocol.churn_selection_metric: unweighted mean development Brier score; lower is better
protocol.spend_selection_metric: unweighted mean development customer gross-sales MAE; lower is better
protocol.policy_selection_metric: unweighted mean development historical-value-weighted inactivity recall at 20% budget; higher is better
protocol.features: base snapshot; 30/60/90-day purchase-days and gross spend; previous-30-day trend; interpurchase cadence; prior inactivity/reactivation
protocol.limitations: Retrospective extension after earlier results were examined. Final period is not unseen. Monthly development follow-ups overlap; folds are not independent. No parameter search or post-test candidate changes. Weighted recall measures pre-cutoff gross-sales exposure among future inactivity events, not recoverable revenue or campaign uplift.
